title: EXPECT GOD TO STEP IN [NO SITUATION IS IMPOSSIBLE]
text: Hallelujah. Glory to God. I want you to lift [music] up your hands wherever you are. Whether you are in this auditorium, whether you are watching online, whether you are listening through audio, I want you to understand that the atmosphere of heaven is thick in this place tonight. The presence of the Lord is here. And I sense in my spirit that somebody [music] is about to receive a turnaround that will shock the kingdom of darkness. Can I have about seven people who believe that God is about to do something unusual? Just seven people who are tired of ordinary, [music] who are tired of the regular, who have come to a place where they understand that except the Lord builds the house, they [music] that labor labor in vain. Can I see your hands? Lift them up high. [music] The Bible says in Jeremiah 32:27, "Behold, I am the Lord, the [music] God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?" That is not a [music] statement. That is a rhetorical question demanding a response from your spirit. You see beloved, [music] we have come to a junction in the body of Christ where many have become familiar with impossibilities. We have [music] trained our minds to accept defeat. We have trained our consciousness to accommodate [music] failure. We have become so used to living below our covenant privileges that when God begins [music] to move, we are shocked. But tonight, I am sent by the spirit of the living God [music] to announce to you that your season of impossibility is over. In the name of Jesus, I need you to understand something. The God we serve [music] is not a God of probabilities. He's a God of possibilities. When man comes to the end of his rope, when human [music] wisdom exhausts itself, when medical science throws up his hands, when the bank manager says there is no solution, when the lawyer says the [music] case is closed, when your family members have given up on you, that is precisely when God steps into the arena. Are you hearing me in this place? The scripture [music] is very clear. In Luke 1:37, the angel declared to Mary, "For with God, [music] nothing shall be impossible." Now, I want you to catch the weight of that word nothing. It is not selective. It is not discriminatory. It is all-encompassing. That thing you [music] are carrying in your heart tonight. That burden that has made you to weep in secret. That situation that has caused you sleepless nights. That financial crisis that seems to have no solution. That sickness the doctors have tagged incurable. That marriage that looks like it's beyond repair. That business that is on life support. That career that has hit a brick wall. That [music] addiction that has held you captive for years. None of them, I repeat, none of them fall outside the jurisdiction of nothing shall be impossible. I am prophesying to somebody tonight. [music] Your Kadesh banana experience is over. You will not die at the edge of your miracle. You will not come permanently at the [music] borders of your breakthrough. The Lord is saying to you, arise and [music] possess the land. Can I get a witness who believes that word? Now, I want to take you through the [music] scriptures tonight because we are not dealing with motivational speaking. We are dealing with the prophetic word of God that cannot lie. I want to show you men and women who stood at the crossroads [music] of impossibility and how God stepped in. Consider Abraham. The Bible says in Romans chapter 4 that Abraham [music] was about a 100 years old and Sarah's womb was dead. Now when the scripture [music] uses the word dead, it is not speaking metaphorically. It was not that she was just old. Her reproductive [music] system had completely shut down. Medical science would have closed that file. The gynecologist would have said, "I'm sorry, but this [music] is biologically impossible." But watch what happened. The Bible says, "Abraham did not stagger [music] the promise of God through unbelief." He considered not his own body now dead, neither yet the deadness of Sarah's womb. He understood a principle that I need you to grasp tonight. When God speaks, [music] biology must bow. When God declares a thing, circumstances must align. Somebody [music] is here tonight and you have been given a medical report that looks final. The diagnosis looks [music] conclusive. But I came to announce to you that your body is not the final authority. The word of God is the final authority. Your bank account is not the final say. God's covenant is the final say. Are you with me? Let me take you to [music] another dimension. The children of Israel stood at the Red Sea. Behind them was Pharaoh's army, the most sophisticated [music] military machine of their time. Before them was water deep, impassible water. To the left and to the right were mountains. [music] By every logical calculation, they were finished. The military strategist would have said, "This is checkmate. [music] There is no escape route." But in that moment of absolute impossibility, Moses lifted up his rod and God parted the waters. What am I saying to you? The thing that looks like your greatest obstacle tonight is about to become your greatest testimony. [music] I feel the anointing of God in this place. Somebody's Red Sea is about to part. That situation that has you surrounded, that problem that seems to have you cornered with no way out. The Lord is saying, "Stand still and see the salvation of the Lord." You don't need to panic. You don't need to manipulate. You don't need to compromise. You just need to position yourself in faith [music] and watch God move. Now, let me bring you to the New Testament. There was a man by the pool of Bethesda who had been in [music] his condition for 38 years. 38 years. That is longer than some of you have been alive. This man had seen THOUSANDS OF DAYS [music] COME AND go with no change. He had heard testimonies of others getting healed, but his own healing never came. He was [music] surrounded by multitudes in the same condition. The blind, the lame, the paralyzed. If you wanted to find an atmosphere [music] of impossibility, that was it. Hopelessness was the air they breathe. But [music] one day Jesus showed up. Are you hearing me? One day the game changer appeared. One day the possibility and impossibility manifested and Jesus asked him [music] a question that seems almost insensitive. Do you want to be made whole? After 38 [music] years, that question sounds cool. But Jesus was not asking about his desire. He was [music] probing his faith. And when that man engaged his faith, even at the most elementary [music] level, Jesus said, "Rise, take up your bed and walk." And immediately [music] the man was made whole. I am prophesying to somebody tonight. Your 38 years are over. that chronic condition, that recurring problem, that generational curse, that stubborn situation that has defied every solution, your deliverance has [music] come tonight in the name of Jesus. Can somebody shout a prophetic hallelujah? You see, the reason many people [music] remain in impossibility is because they have not understood the nature of the God they serve. We serve El Shadai, the God who is more than enough. We serve Jehovah Gyra, the Lord who provides. We serve Jehovah Rafa, the Lord who heals. [music] We serve the ancient of days whose years have no end. We serve the allsufficient one who does not need permission from your situation to change it. Let me tell you what happens when God steps in. When God steps in, barness becomes fruitfulness. When God steps in, sickness becomes health. When God steps in, [music] poverty becomes prosperity. When God steps in, confusion becomes clarity. When God steps in, depression becomes joy. When God steps in, captivity becomes liberty. I said when God steps in, impossibility [music] becomes possibility. The woman with the issue of blood had spent all her resources on physicians. The Bible says she had suffered many things from many doctors. She [music] had been to the best specialists. She had tried every known remedy. Her condition was [music] not improving. It was worsening. Medically speaking, she was a hopeless case. Financially speaking, she was bankrupt. Socially speaking, she was an outcast. [music] But she heard about Jesus. Can I tell you something? Your breakthrough might be [music] in what you are hearing right now. Your miracle might be in this word that is being released into the atmosphere. She said within [music] herself, "If I may but touch the hem of his garment, I shall be made whole." That was not presumption. [music] That was faith making a demand on the supernatural. And when she touched him, immediately the fountain of her blood [music] was dried up. Jesus said, "Daughter, your faith has made you whole." Somebody here [music] tonight, your years of hemorrhaging are over. That thing that has been draining you financially, draining you emotionally, draining you spiritually, draining you physically, the bleeding stops tonight, I declare by the authority of heaven, the hemorrhaging stops now in Jesus name. Now I want you to see something about the nature of God [music] stepping in. When God steps in, he does not just solve the problem. He exceeds your expectations. Look at the feeding [music] of the 5,000. The disciples came to Jesus with a legitimate crisis. They said, "Master, send the multitude away so they can go buy food." That was logical. That was [music] practical. That was responsible advice. But Jesus said, "You give them something to eat." Can you imagine the shock on their faces? They looked at the multitude, 5,000 men, not counting women and children, conservative estimate, 20,000 people. And they had five loaves and two fish. The mathematics did not add up. The resources were grossly inadequate. But Jesus took what they had, blessed it, broke it, and fed the multitude until they were satisfied. And after everyone had eaten, they gathered 12 baskets full of [music] leftovers. Do you see the nature of God? When God steps into your situation, he does not just give you enough, he gives you overflow. [music] He does not just solve the problem, he gives you surplus. The barrel of meals shall not waste and the cru of oil [music] shall not fail. You will eat and be satisfied and have leftovers. This is the God we serve. I sense in my spirit [music] that somebody watching this message is in a situation where the resources are completely inadequate for [music] the demand. The salary is not matching the bills. The capital is not sufficient [music] for the business. The strength is not enough for the assignment. But [music] I hear the spirit of God saying, "Bring what you have to me and I will multiply it. Your [music] five loaves and two fish are about to feed multitudes." Let me take you deeper. The Bible says [music] in 2 Kings chapter 4 that there was a widow whose husband had died and left her in debt. The creditor [music] was coming to take her two sons as slaves. She was at the end of her rope. She came to the prophet crying and Elisha asked her, "What do you have in your house?" She said, "I have nothing except a pot of oil." Now, watch this. God did not send an angel with a bankdraft. God did not cause [music] money to fall from heaven. God used what she had. He multiplied the ordinary to produce the extraordinary. The prophet told her, "Go borrow vessels, empty vessels, and don't borrow just a few." Then she poured from her little pot of oil into those vessels, [music] and the oil kept flowing. It filled vessel after vessel after vessel. The Bible says the oil only stopped when there were no more vessels. She sold the oil, paid her debt, and she and her sons lived on the rest. Somebody needs to hear this. Your limitation is not [music] in what you have. Your limitation is in your capacity to receive. God is ready to pour, but you need to create capacity. You need to enlarge your expectations. You need to expand your vision. You need to increase your vessels. Stop thinking small. Stop limiting [music] God with your small faith. The oil is flowing, but you need bigger vessels. I am declaring to you tonight, financial embarrassment is [music] over for somebody. That debt that has held you captive. The Lord is releasing supernatural provision to pay it off. You will not just be debtree. You will have surplus. You will not just meet your needs. You will be a blessing to others. This is your season of overflow. Now let me address those who are [music] facing spiritual battles. Maybe your situation is not just natural. It is satanic. Maybe you are not just dealing with circumstances. You are dealing with demonic resistance. Maybe there are powers that have been assigned against your destiny, against your family, against your progress. I want you to know that when God steps [music] in, every knee must bow. Philippians 2:10 says that at the name of Jesus, every knee should bow of things in heaven, things in earth, and things under the earth. When God steps in, principalities lose their authority. When God steps in, witchcraft [music] loses its potency. When God steps in, familiar spirits are rendered powerless. When God steps in, ancestral covenants are nullified. When God steps in, [music] generational curses are broken. I said when God steps in, the kingdom of darkness is put to shame. Look at what happened at the tomb of Lazarus. [music] Lazarus had been dead for 4 days. In Jewish culture, they believe that after 3 [music] days, the spirit completely left the body and decay would set in. So by every measure, this was not just death. [music] This was advanced death. This was decomposition. Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, by now he stings." That was a polite way of saying it's too late. The situation has gone beyond repair. But Jesus said, "Did I not tell you that if you believe you will [music] see the glory of God?" And then Jesus did something that defied logic. [music] He stood at that tomb and cried with A LOUD VOICE, "LAZARUS, come forth." And the Bible says, "He that was dead came forth bound hand and foot with grave clothes." Now, I want you to understand something. When Jesus [music] spoke, death had no choice but to obey. When Jesus spoke, decay had to reverse. When Jesus spoke, impossibility became possibility. I am speaking to somebody's death situation tonight. That dream that died, that vision that was aborted, that business that collapsed, that marriage that looks dead, that ministry that was shut down, I hear the voice of the Lord saying, "Come forth. What was dead is coming back to life. What was buried is being resurrected. What was written off is being restored. Your Lazarus moment [music] has come. You need to understand that God specializes in dead situations. He's the God of resurrection. He's the God who calls those things that be not as though they were. He's the God who quickens the dead. Romans 4:1 17 says, "He gives life to the dead [music] and calls things that do not exist as though they did." That means before the manifestation, God has already declared it done. Before you see it in the physical, it is already accomplished in [music] the spiritual. Are you hearing me? The three Hebrew boys, Shedrach, Meshach, and Abednego, stood before Nebuchadnezzar's furnace. The king said to them, "Who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands?" That was not [music] just a question. That was a challenge. That was arrogance speaking. That was earthly authority defying [music] heavenly authority. And the fire was heated seven times hotter than usual. The soldiers who [music] threw them in were killed by the heat. By every natural analysis, those boys were finished. But when they went into the fire, they did not go alone. The king looked into the furnace and said, "Did we not cast three men [music] bound into the fire?" I see four men loose walking [music] in the midst of the fire, and the form of the fourth is like the son of God. When God steps in, you [music] don't just survive, you overcome. When God steps in, what was meant to destroy you becomes your platform of promotion. When God steps in, you walk through the fire and come out without [music] even the smell of smoke. I prophesy to somebody, you will come out of this trial without scars. You will emerge from this battle without [music] wounds. The enemy thought this situation would destroy you, but you are coming out promoted. You are coming out elevated. [music] You are coming out celebrated. The fire will not consume you. It will refine you. Daniel was thrown into the lion's den. A stone [music] was placed over the mouth of the den and sealed with the king's signate. That seal meant it was final. No one could reverse it. The lions had been stabbed so they would be aggressive. Daniel was an old man, physically vulnerable, but the Bible says God sent [music] his angel and shut the lion's mouth. When the king came in the morning, [music] Daniel was untouched. Not a scratch, not a bruise, not a tear in his clothing. When God steps in, what has the capacity to devour you? Loses its appetite. When God steps in, your enemies become your foottool. Somebody's in a den tonight. Maybe it is [music] a corporate den, a family den, a financial den, a health den. You feel surrounded by forces that want to tear you apart. But I hear the Lord saying, "I am shutting the mouth of every [music] lion assigned against you. They will have no power to haunt you. You will emerge victorious. You will come out vindicated." Let me tell you what happens when you expect God [music] to step in. Expectation is not passive. Expectation is active faith. The Bible says in Hebrews [music] 11:1, "Faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen." Your expectation gives substance [music] to what God has promised. Your expectation creates evidence in the realm of the spirit before it manifests in the realm of the physical. The Shunamite woman in 2 [music] Kings chapter 4 had a son through a prophetic word. That son grew up and one day he went to the field and complained of a headache. [music] They brought him home and he sat on his mother's lap and died at noon. Now watch [music] her response. She did not call a funeral director. She did not start mourning. She laid him on the bed of the man of God, shut the door and went to find Elisha. When her husband asked why she was going, she said, "It [music] is well." Her son was dead, but she said, "It is well." That is the language [music] of expectation. When Elisha's servant asked if all was well, she said, "It is well." That was not denial. That was faith [music] speaking. She knew something that many of us have forgotten. The situation is not over until God says it is over. She got to Elisha and when the prophet saw her, he said to Ghazi, "Her soul is vexed, but the Lord has hidden it from me." God had deliberately withheld the information from the prophet so that the woman's faith could [music] be tested and demonstrated. Elisha went with her and when they got to the house, the Bible says he went in, shut the door, and prayed. Then he stretched himself upon the child. [music] And the child sneezed seven times and opened his eyes. What was dead came back to life. Why? Because that woman expected God to step in. She refused to accept [music] death as final. She refused to bow to impossibility. I am speaking to your expectation tonight. Raise it. Lift it. Expand it. God is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that you can ask [music] or think. You have limited God with your low expectations. You have [music] capped your miracle with your small thinking. But tonight, the ceiling is [music] being removed. The limitations are being destroyed. Your capacity to receive is being enlarged. Now, I want to pray with you. But before I pray, I need you to do something. [music] I need you to take a moment and identify that situation in your life that looks impossible. Maybe it [music] is multiple situations. I need you to see it clearly in your mind. See the mountain. See the obstacle. See the impossibility. And now [music] I want you to hear the word of the Lord from Zechariah 4:7. Who are you, oh great mountain? Before Zerubbabel, you shall become a plain. That mountain is not going to diminish gradually. It is going to become a plane. It is not going to reduce slowly. It is [music] going to disappear suddenly. Lift up your hands wherever you are. Whether you are standing, whether you are sitting, [music] whether you are lying down, I want you to lift up your hands as a sign of surrender, as a sign of expectation, as a sign of reception. Open your mouth and begin [music] to pray in the Holy Ghost. Pray in tongues if you have the gift. Pray in your understanding if you don't. But pray with expectation. Pray with authority. Pray with confidence. This is not the time to [music] beg. This is the time to declare. This is the time to prophesy to your situation. Father, in the name of Jesus, [music] I stand in the gap for everyone hearing this message right now. I thank you, Lord, that you are the God of impossibilities. I thank you that what is impossible with men is possible [music] with you. I decree and I declare that every situation that [music] has been tagged impossible, every circumstance that has been labeled hopeless, every condition that has been called incurable, [music] every problem that has been termed unsolvable, we command them to bow to the name of Jesus. We release the fire of the Holy Ghost upon every stubborn situation. [music] We command barrenness to give way to fruitfulness. We command sickness to give way to health. We command poverty to give way [music] to prosperity. We command confusion to give way to clarity. We command bondage to give way to liberty. In the mighty name of Jesus, I speak to that financial crisis right now. You embargo of poverty, you limitation of lack, you spirit of insufficiency, we command you to be broken. We release the windows of heaven over the lives of God's people. We decree that they shall lend to nations and not borrow. We [music] decree that they shall be above only and not beneath. We decree that whatever they lay their hands upon shall prosper. The divor is rebuked for your sake. Your band shall be filled with plenty. Your v shall overflow with new wine. I speak to that health situation. You spirit of infirmity, [music] you disease, you sickness, you ailment, we command you to lose your hold. By the stripes of Jesus, we declare healing. We speak to that body and command every organ to function properly. We command every cell to align with divine health. We decree that you shall live and not die. You shall declare the [music] works of the Lord. Long life is your portion. Divine health is your inheritance. Be healed in the name of Jesus. I speak to that marriage that is in crisis. You spirit of divorce, [music] you demon of separation, you force of strife, we bind you and cast you out. We release the love of God [music] into that home. We decree that what God has joined together, no man, no demon, no circumstance shall put us under. We decree restoration. We decree reconciliation. [music] We decree that your marriage shall be a testimony. It shall be a covenant marriage. It shall be a glory marriage in Jesus name. I speak to that business that is struggling. You embargo of stagnation. You limitation of the enemy. you economic warfare, we break your power. We decree that dates of brass [music] shall be broken. We decree that bars of iron shall be cut in two. We decree that hidden treasures shall be revealed. We decree that your business [music] shall prosper. You shall have good success. The Lord shall command a blessing upon you. Your storehouse shall be filled in Jesus name. I speak to that [music] baress. You womb that has been closed. You destiny that has been locked, [music] you potential that has been suppressed, we command you to open. We speak to that womb like we spoke to Sarah's womb. We declare that you shall conceive, you shall carry, you shall deliver, your children shall be mighty upon the earth. The generation of the upright shall be blessed. This is your [music] season of fruitfulness. I speak to that student struggling academically. You spirit of mental blockage, you force of limitation, you confusion in the realm of knowledge, we cast you out. We decree that the spirit of wisdom and understanding shall rest upon you. We decree [music] supernatural intelligence. We decree photographic memory. We decree that you shall excel. You shall be distinguished. You shall be celebrated. Excellence is your portion in Jesus name. I speak to every generational course that has been following your family line. You evil altar, you ancient covenant, you ancestral dedication, we nullify you by the blood [music] of Jesus. We decree that the iniquity of the father shall not visit the children. We decree that every chain [music] of heredity is broken. We decree that you are the last generation to experience that curse. It ends with you. Your children shall walk in freedom. Your lineage [music] shall walk in blessing. The curse is broken in Jesus name. I speak to that addiction that has held you captive. You spirit of bondage, you demonic attachment, you chain of habit, we command you to break. We decree that whom [music] the son sets free is free indeed. We declare liberty to the captives. We declare freedom to the prisoners. You shall be free. You shall walk in dominion. You shall walk in self-control. The power of that addiction is destroyed [music] right now in Jesus name. And now Father, I pray for a supernatural expectation [music] to rise in the hearts of your people. Remove every doubt. Remove every fear. Remove every unbelief. Let them know that you are the God who specializes in impossibilities. [music] Let them know that nothing is too hard for you. Let them [music] know that you are the same yesterday, today, and forever. What you did for Abraham, you can do for them. What you did for Moses, you [music] can do for them. What you did for David, you can do for them. What you did for Elijah, you can do for them. What you did for Peter, you can do for them. I decree that divine intervention is coming into [music] your life. I decree that supernatural turnarounds are manifesting. I decree that [music] what has taken years shall be accomplished in days. I decree acceleration. I decree acceleration. I decree acceleration. You shall possess your possession. You shall inherit your inheritance. You shall walk in your destiny. And I seal these prayers with the blood of Jesus. I seal these declarations with the blood of Jesus. Let every word that has gone forth tonight take root in good ground and produce a harvest. Let testimonies arise. Let miracles manifest. Let breakthroughs come forth for the glory of God and the advancement of his kingdom. Now receive your miracle in the name of Jesus. Receive your breakthrough in the name of Jesus. Receive your deliverance in the name of Jesus. It is done. It is finished. It is sealed in the mighty, powerful, awesome, matchless, peerless, incomparable name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Amen and amen. Now somebody give the Lord a praise. If you believe that God has stepped into your situation tonight, if you believe that your impossibility has become possibility, if you believe that your breakthrough has come, open your mouth and worship him. Magnify his name. Exalt his name, for he is worthy to be praised. Hallelujah.
